grammarRule.formula: I / He / She / It + was | You / We / They + were

explanation.ml: കഴിഞ്ഞകാലത്തെ അവസ്ഥകളെയും സന്ദർഭങ്ങളെയും സൂചിപ്പിക്കാൻ ഏകവചനത്തിൽ 'was' (ആയിരുന്നു) എന്നും, ബഹുവചനത്തിലും 'You' എന്നതിനൊപ്പവും 'were' (ആയിരുന്നു) എന്നും ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Past State: Was vs Were with clear formula: I / He / She / It + was | You / We / They + were

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 'I was at home yesterday' (ഞാൻ ഇന്നലെ വീട്ടിലായിരുന്നു). 'They were very happy' (അവർ വളരെ സന്തോഷത്തിലായിരുന്നു). 'You' എപ്പോഴും 'were' മാത്രമേ എടുക്കൂ ('You were right').
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 'I was at home yesterday' (ഞാൻ ഇന്നലെ വീട്ടിലായിരുന്നു). 'They were very happy' (അവർ വളരെ സന്തോഷത്തിലായിരുന്നു). 'You' എപ്പോഴും 'were' മാത്രമേ എടുക്കൂ ('You were right').

nouns.definition: Completely depleted of physical or mental energy.
nouns.example: I was completely exhausted after the ten-kilometer trek.

nouns.definition: Feeling or showing great pleasure and happiness.
nouns.example: We were delighted to meet our school childhood friends.

nouns.definition: Not present in a place, at an occasion, or as part of something.
nouns.example: Why were you absent from the morning team meeting?

nouns.definition: Full of people, leaving little or no room for movement.
nouns.example: The central bus terminal was extremely crowded yesterday evening.

nouns.definition: Eager to know or learn something.
nouns.example: The students were curious to see the science laboratory exhibits.

nouns.definition: Happening or doing something at the agreed or proper time.
nouns.example: He was remarkably punctual throughout his thirty-year career.

sentences.text: Fifty years ago, Captain David was the trusted keeper of the rocky island lighthouse.
sentences.meaningMl: അമ്പത് വർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് മുൻപ്, പാറക്കെട്ടുകൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ദ്വീപിലെ വിളക്കുമാടത്തിന്റെ വിശ്വസ്തനായ സൂക്ഷിപ്പുകാരനായിരുന്നു ക്യാപ്റ്റൻ ഡേവിഡ്.
sentences.meaningHi: पचास साल पहले, कैप्टन डेविड चट्टानी द्वीप के लाइटहाउस के भरोसेमंद रक्षक थे।
sentences.meaningTa: ஐம்பது ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு, கேப்டன் டேவிட் பாறைத் தீவின் கலங்கரை விளக்கக் காப்பாளராக இருந்தார்.
sentences.audioPrompt: Fifty years ago, Captain David was the trusted keeper of the rocky island lighthouse.

sentences.text: The stormy sea waves were ferocious and unpredictable during winter nights.

sentences.meaningHi: सर्दियों की रातों में तूफानी समुद्री लहरें भयंकर और अप्रत्याशित थीं।
sentences.meaningTa: குளிர்கால இரவுகளில் சீற்றமடைந்த அலைகள் கொடூரமாக இருந்தன.
sentences.audioPrompt: The stormy sea waves were ferocious and unpredictable during winter nights.

sentences.text: Whenever thick fog was across the harbor, David was alert at the revolving brass beacon.
sentences.meaningMl: തുറമുഖത്ത് കനത്ത മൂടൽമഞ്ഞ് ഉണ്ടാകുമ്പോഴെല്ലാം ഡേവിഡ് തിരിയുന്ന പിച്ചള വിളക്കിനടുത്ത് ജാഗരൂകനായിരുന്നു.
sentences.meaningHi: जब भी बंदरगाह पर घना कोहरा होता था, डेविड घूमते हुए पीतल के प्रकाशस्तंभ पर सतर्क रहता था।
sentences.meaningTa: துறைமுகத்தில் பனிமூட்டம் இருக்கும்போதெல்லாம் டேவிட் சுழலும் விளக்குடன் விழிப்பாக இருந்தார்.
sentences.audioPrompt: Whenever thick fog was across the harbor, David was alert at the revolving brass beacon.

sentences.text: Fishermen on wooden trawlers were deeply grateful for his shining yellow guide beam.

sentences.meaningHi: लकड़ी की नावों पर मछुआरे उसकी चमकती पीली किरण के लिए बहुत आभारी थे।

traps.question: Select the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement for 'You':
options: You was right about the venue location.
You were right about the venue location.
You was being right about location.
traps.explanation: 'You' in English ALWAYS takes 'were' in the past, whether singular or plural: 'You were right'.
traps.ruleHint: Subject-Verb Agreement: You always takes 'were', never 'was'.

traps.question: Choose the correct past state sentence for plural people:
options: My parents was at the railway station.
My parents were at the railway station.
My parents is at the station yesterday.
My parents was were at station.
traps.explanation: 'Parents' is a plural noun, requiring 'were': 'My parents were at the railway station.'

traps.question: How do you ask if someone was busy yesterday?
traps.explanation: 'Were you busy yesterday?' correctly inverts 'were' with 'you' for a past adjective question.
